name: Summer Internship or minor project
description: Students will be interning in an organization to develop experience in application of chemical science principles and to develop skills in communication, working efficiently in a team, learn to collaborate and gain exposure to practical/industry relevant problems in chemistry. Students will be assigned a project by their reporting officer, where they have to work on problems related to their internship using engineering methods.
